artboards.title: What a step has to come back as

annotations.text:
WHERE THE SPACE WENT

The shipped panel spends four rows on chrome before any content: the band, then a second LIVE CODE / Listening row that repeats it, then Hold and Compact as 30pt chips, then a file row, then a five-button row.

All of it is gone. Controls are bare glyphs in the band, the way Quiz does it — tertiary ink, no chip, a circle only on hover. Keys drop to one 16pt hint row: a word, then the cap.

The card keeps 302 of the 340. The code plane alone holds 186 of that.

THE CODE

Four things make a step readable at a glance, and the current renderer has none of them:

1. Real file line numbers. `CodingCodeFormatter` numbers 1..n from the snippet — useless next to an editor sitting on line 118.
2. A change sign per line: + added, − removed, · context. Context drops to 55% so the eye lands on what is new.
3. Notes anchored to a line, not appended as prose. Two at most, each saying why that line is there.
4. An honest window: the fold marker says how much is above.

Syntax colours are the shipped ones — keyword #B3A6FF, string #A3DBAB, number #FFC280, comment #969696.

THE DESCRIPTION

Today `codeWithGuidance` appends Why / Limitation / Pending / Say next / Check / Watch into the code scroll, so you scroll past the code to read them — and Say next then draws a second time below the pane.

Split by what each one is about:

· About the step — the title, full width above the code.
· About a line — a numbered note in the code plane's footer.
· About the conversation — Say and Why, one line each, under the code where you look up from typing.
· About the run — Check is the Run key, not a sentence.

Collapsed keeps Say and the code. Support drops, the panel does not.

IT HAS TO COME BACK THIS WAY

None of the above can be rendered from `code: String?`. The engine cannot infer which lines are new, which file line they land on, or what is worth a note — so the model has to say.

The sheet below is the shape, and the rules the engine enforces before a move is ever shown. A move that fails them is refused and asked again rather than drawn plain.
